exemplars.input: The committee reviewed the proposal in detail; however, it was ultimately rejected because the budget was considered too large and the timeline was deemed unrealistic by several members.
exemplars.output: The committee read the proposal closely. They rejected it. The budget was too big, and several members thought the timeline couldn't work.

exemplars.input: In 2019, Maria Chen filed the report with the regional office; although the findings were clear, nobody in Lisbon acted on them for a period of several months.
exemplars.output: Maria Chen filed the report with the regional office in 2019. The findings were clear. Nobody in Lisbon did anything for months.

exemplars.input: It is generally recommended that users update their passwords on a regular basis, utilizing a combination of letters, numbers and symbols, in order to minimize the likelihood of unauthorized access.
exemplars.output: Change your password often. Use letters, numbers and symbols. That makes it harder for someone to break in.

exemplars.input: The quarterly results, which were announced on Tuesday, exceeded analysts' expectations; revenue increased by 12 percent, while operating costs remained essentially flat compared with the previous quarter.
exemplars.output: The quarterly results came out on Tuesday. They beat what analysts expected. Revenue rose 12 percent, and operating costs stayed flat.

exemplars.input: Participants who completed the survey indicated that, in the majority of cases, the primary obstacle to adoption was not cost but rather a lack of adequate training and support.
exemplars.output: Most people who finished the survey said the same thing. Cost wasn't the problem. They didn't get enough training or support.

exemplars.input: Despite extensive efforts to facilitate communication between the two departments, misunderstandings continued to arise, largely as a consequence of inconsistent terminology and the absence of a shared documentation system.
exemplars.output: The two departments kept misunderstanding each other. People tried hard to fix it. The real causes were mixed-up terms and no shared documentation.

exemplars.input: The museum, which was founded in 1884 by a group of local merchants, houses approximately 40,000 objects, a considerable number of which have never been displayed to the public.
exemplars.output: A group of local merchants founded the museum in 1884. It holds about 40,000 objects. Many have never been shown to the public.

exemplars.input: Prior to initiating the installation procedure, it is essential that all existing data be backed up, since the process will overwrite the contents of the primary drive without further confirmation.
exemplars.output: Back up your data before you install. The process wipes the main drive. It won't ask again.

exemplars.input: Although the new policy was intended to reduce waiting times, preliminary data from the first three months suggest that it has had a negligible effect, and in some clinics waiting times have actually increased.
exemplars.output: The new policy was meant to cut waiting times. Three months in, it hasn't. Some clinics are now slower.

exemplars.input: Researchers at the University of Oslo have identified a previously unknown species of moss in the Svalbard archipelago, which they believe may be capable of surviving extended periods of complete darkness.
exemplars.output: Researchers at the University of Oslo found a new moss in Svalbard. They think it can survive long stretches of total darkness.

exemplars.input: Owing to the fact that the venue had been double-booked, the organizers were compelled to relocate the event at short notice to a smaller hall, which unfortunately could not accommodate all of the registered attendees.
exemplars.output: The venue was double-booked. The organizers had to move the event to a smaller hall at the last minute. Not everyone who registered could fit.

exemplars.input: The software update, which is scheduled for release on 3 March, introduces a redesigned settings menu as well as a number of performance improvements that are expected to reduce start-up time by roughly 30 percent.
exemplars.output: The update ships on 3 March. It has a new settings menu and runs faster. Start-up should be about 30 percent quicker.
